meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里装好 Vercel CLI,配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭证,让 agent 能部署 Web 应用到 Vercel。安装由它自动完成。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;若 OneCLI 未就绪,会先让你运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 给 agent 装上 Vercel 部署能力
say.note: 会安装 CLI 并配置 Vercel 凭证

say.text: 帮我把这个 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我 Vercel 上的部署记录

howto.what_en: Claude installs the Vercel CLI in NanoClaw agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection, so agents can deploy web apps to Vercel. It handles install, secrets, skill sync and restarts, only asking you to paste a token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it asks you to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Set up Vercel deployment for the agents
say_en.note: Installs the CLI and configures credentials

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production
